legacy_raw.note: edge_strength.analyse on CELLS raw captures; equals edge_strength.json _summary

legacy_matched.note: legacy pipeline (all-rows fit, b0 = m a0 + c, 400 Euclidean draws) on the 185 matched (Zs, Zjm)

predict_unmatched.note: legacy = positive_control.part_b on raw captures (reproduces ledger predict.*); corrected = positive_control_heldout.row_protocol on the same (Zs, Zj)

meta.strong_definition: sd(b | patch-A arm)/sd(b | patch-B arm) >= 0.1; corrected variants compute it on the protocol's training single-site rows, legacy variants on all rows
meta.gC_primary: (a - a0)(b - b0), b0 = recorded clean B (Zc patch-A arm, training rows) = Table 1 clamped column
meta.gC_edge_b0: (a - a0)(b - m a0 - c), train-fitted: edge_strength.py's definition
meta.null: rnd_p95: Euclidean random same-class directions (200 draws corrected, 400 legacy); summary_inv_null uses the basis-invariant G_ref^{-1/2} null
meta.ci: 2000 resamples of the 38 (cell, prompt) groups; percentile 95%
